notes: A contradiction entry is a governance proposal. prerequisites: the clashing source entries exist in the catalog. effects: the chosen resolution id (null while the vote is open) plus the arithmetic that exposes the clash. validation: sources non-empty and resolving, at least one proposed resolution, chosen_resolution (when set) is one of the proposed ids; resolved entries keep their choice.

contra_life_vs_printed_hits.description: Open. Rule 14 Part B derives life as round_half_up(sum(stats) / 10) (life_from_stats) but five creature cards print a different hit count: Cloudhearth Drake 54 -> 5 vs 6, Tangle Spider 65 -> 7 vs 4, Bant Battlemage 64 -> 6 vs 5, Rhox Brute 50 -> 5 vs 6, Ember Weaver 65 -> 7 vs 6. The collection rule unit_life_matches_stats flags exactly these five as WARN until a resolution wins: formula_wins (engine derives life, data.life is a cache), card_wins (optional life_override + Rule 14 'unless the card prints otherwise') or fix_stats (rebalance the stats to match the printed hits).

prerequisites.description: Every source entry (rule_14 and the five creatures) exists in the catalog.

effects.description: The winning resolution id, null while the vote is open.
Per evidence row: printed hits minus the Rule 14 formula life (non-zero = the clash).
The formula life recomputed from the canonical stats of the first flagged creature (Cloudhearth Drake).
True while no resolution has been chosen.

contra_razorfin_stat_sum.description: Open. char_razorfin_abolisher prints stats 5/5/20/0 (sum 30) and 4 hits, while the concept's species_sum_rule says playable races have sum 40 and Rule 14 gives 4 life only for 40 (30 -> 3). Resolutions: typo_15_5_20_0 (Vitality 15), typo_5_15_20_0 (World 15) or intentional_30 (keep 30, life 3, compensating property). The collection rule unit_life_matches_stats flags the character as WARN meanwhile.

contra_rule0_duplicate_numbering.description: Resolved (merge_into_rule0). contra_rule21_rounding.description: Resolved (round_half_up). Rule 21 says 'rounded up at mathematical principle' yet its Example 2 rounds 4 points down to 0; a ceiling would give 1. The ruling is standard rounding at the nearest multiple of 10 (round_div10: 5 -> 1, 4 -> 0), recorded in rule_21.formula and battle_system_core.resolution_math. The logic re-evaluates both examples so a change to the rounding operator shows up here.

Rule 21 Example 2: 2 + 2 = 4 points -> 0 damage (the ceiling reading would give 1).

contra_golems_stat_totals.description: Resolved (no_change).
